  • Method Details

    • isEnabled

      public boolean isEnabled()
      Whether to serve HTTP/3 on the HTTPS port. When enabled and TLS is enabled, an HTTP/3 (QUIC) listener is bound to the UDP port with the same number as the HTTPS port, next to the implicit TCP listeners, using the same TLS configuration. This has no effect when listeners are configured explicitly. Default value (false).
      Returns:
      Whether to serve HTTP/3 on the HTTPS port
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • setEnabled

      public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
      Whether to serve HTTP/3 on the HTTPS port. When enabled and TLS is enabled, an HTTP/3 (QUIC) listener is bound to the UDP port with the same number as the HTTPS port, next to the implicit TCP listeners, using the same TLS configuration. This has no effect when listeners are configured explicitly. Default value (false).
      Parameters:
      enabled - Whether to serve HTTP/3 on the HTTPS port
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • isAltSvc

      public boolean isAltSvc()
      Whether to advertise the HTTP/3 listener with an Alt-Svc header (RFC 7838) on the responses sent over HTTPS with HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2, so that clients can discover HTTP/3. Defaults to the value of isEnabled().
      Returns:
      Whether to send the Alt-Svc header
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • setAltSvc

      public void setAltSvc(@Nullable Boolean altSvc)
      Whether to advertise the HTTP/3 listener with an Alt-Svc header (RFC 7838) on the responses sent over HTTPS with HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2, so that clients can discover HTTP/3. Defaults to the value of isEnabled(). Set it to true to advertise an explicitly configured QUIC listener.
      Parameters:
      altSvc - Whether to send the Alt-Svc header
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • getAltSvcMaxAge

      public @Nullable Duration getAltSvcMaxAge()
      The time clients may cache the HTTP/3 advertisement, sent as the ma parameter of the Alt-Svc header. When not set, the parameter is omitted and clients use the default of 24 hours.
      Returns:
      The time clients may cache the advertisement, or null
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • setAltSvcMaxAge

      public void setAltSvcMaxAge(@Nullable Duration altSvcMaxAge)
      The time clients may cache the HTTP/3 advertisement, sent as the ma parameter of the Alt-Svc header. When not set, the parameter is omitted and clients use the default of 24 hours.
      Parameters:
      altSvcMaxAge - The time clients may cache the advertisement, or null
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • getAltSvcPort

      public @Nullable Integer getAltSvcPort()
      The port to advertise in the Alt-Svc header, when clients reach the HTTP/3 listener on another port than the one it is bound to, e.g. behind a container port mapping or a load balancer. When not set, the bound port is advertised.
      Returns:
      The port to advertise, or null
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • setAltSvcPort

      public void setAltSvcPort(@Nullable Integer altSvcPort)
      The port to advertise in the Alt-Svc header, when clients reach the HTTP/3 listener on another port than the one it is bound to, e.g. behind a container port mapping or a load balancer. When not set, the bound port is advertised.
      Parameters:
      altSvcPort - The port to advertise, or null
      Since:
      5.3.0
